info.title: WG-Guard API
info.description: REST management surface of the WG-Guard AmneziaWG node panel. This document is a V1 compatibility contract: additive changes only — no field renames, no meaning changes, no removed enum values. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer wg_…` API tokens (scopes below). Reseller-bound tokens use explicit ownership-checked routes; legacy mutations and node-wide aggregates remain unavailable except owned usage reset. All errors use one envelope (`error.code` is a stable machine code). Legacy mutating endpoints with `Idempotency-Key` use token-scoped 24-hour response replay; they do not gain atomic multi-request semantics or result lookup. New purchases commit the user, initial device, customer link and non-secret result together; `Idempotency-Key` identifies that result for 90 days within the owner or reseller namespace. Lists are cursor-paginated (`limit` ≤ 500 + opaque `cursor`).

get.summary: Public readiness probe (bring-up complete, DB reachable)
Public capability discovery: version + liveness only
Bounded live node and VPN telemetry
get.description: Returns the newest shared in-memory samples in chronological order. Unavailable measurements are null; interface names and raw errors are never returned. History is ephemeral across process restarts.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Newest samples to return; values above the cap are clamped.

post.summary: Provision a customer, first device and subscription link atomically
post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key unique within the owner or reseller namespace. An identical retry returns the same 201 result with Idempotency-Replayed: true; a different request with that key returns 409. A reseller may use only an enabled plan assigned by the owner. An omitted username is derived stably from the principal and key. Database commit does not assert a successful live VPN handshake. The result contains no capability link or private configuration; retrieve those separately with appropriate permissions.

201.description: Committed purchase; same body on replay

get.summary: Recover a committed integration result by key
get.description: The key is supplied in a header to keep it out of URL logs. Lookup is scoped to the owner or reseller principal and retained for 90 days; a missing or expired result is 404. It does not expose subscription capabilities or private keys.

post.description: Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`. Limit fields are tri-state: absent = unlimited (create), `null` = clear to unlimited (update), value = set. Speed limits are independent per direction (kbps).
Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`. One transaction: either all created users exist or none. Taken usernames are skipped (usernames stay reserved after soft delete).

post.summary: Apply one action to many users (per-item results)

patch.summary: Partially update a user (username immutable; `null` clears a limit)

delete.summary: Soft-delete a user (username stays reserved; peers removed)

get.summary: Retrieve a customer's private subscription link
get.description: The path is a bearer capability relative to this panel's public origin. Resolve it against the configured public base URL or the API origin before delivery. The link and device configurations are secrets; the response is no-store. Reseller tokens can read only their own customers. A missing or revoked link returns 404.

post.summary: Revoke the old link and every old device configuration
post.description: Atomically replaces the customer link and every device key, preserving device IDs, addresses and quotas. Old links, configs and QR values stop working after successful runtime reconciliation. If reconciliation fails, the new database state is retained and the response is 503; read the current link before retrying. This operation intentionally does not use the legacy response-replay middleware.

200.description: New private link and count of rotated devices

503.description: Database rotation committed; runtime reconciliation pending

get.description: Returns null when no successor is queued. Reseller tokens can read only their own customers.

put.summary: Queue or replace one authorized successor
put.description: No payment is taken. The caller must have already authorized this entitlement. Plan terms are snapshotted when queued, so later catalog edits or reseller-plan revocation do not rewrite it. At the first time or quota boundary the new plan starts once, with fresh usage counters. A manual suspension/disable blocks automatic activation. A changed current plan or incompatible device set moves the queue to needs_review. Optional carry_unused_traffic adds only unused prior traffic when time ends first, never time. Reseller tokens require an owner-assigned enabled plan. Optional Idempotency-Key provides token-scoped 24-hour replay.

delete.description: Idempotent removal; it does not reverse an already activated plan. Optional Idempotency-Key provides token-scoped 24-hour replay.

get.description: Returns newest first, at most 100, retained for one year. Includes non-secret before/after entitlement snapshots and the actual first boundary trigger. Reseller tokens see only their own customers. This read is the fallback when an asynchronous notification is missed.

post.description: Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`. Reactivates expired accounts; traffic_exceeded accounts are NOT reactivated here (quota recovery is an explicit admin action).

post.summary: Add traffic to the charged counters
post.description: Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`. Pushing the total to/over the limit trips the account immediately.

post.summary: Set the charged counters to absolute values
post.description: Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`. `null` leaves a counter untouched; landing below the limit reactivates a traffic_exceeded account.

Idempotent with `Idempotency-Key`. Zeroes user and device totals while retaining peer baselines; a traffic_exceeded account returns to active (or waiting per policy). Reseller tokens can reset only owned customers.

get.summary: Traffic time series for the user's devices

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Window; capped by retention (samples 48, hourly 720, daily 8760)

delete.summary: Delete a device (IP released; peer removed)

post.description: The old peer key is revoked by reconciliation (matched by device IP), the new key is applied.

get.description: Requires configs.read; contains the private key — treat as a secret. Returns the canonical full-field configuration bytes shared by the admin and subscription downloads, ending in exactly one newline. Response headers include `Cache-Control: no-store` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`; the `Content-Disposition` filename has a short ASCII username label (up to six characters), a hyphen, and a stable eight-character device code followed by `.conf`. Optional downloads.filename_prefix/suffix each contribute at most two characters to the label. The profile-name stem is at most 15 characters.

get.summary: Client configuration as a PNG QR code
get.description: Encodes the exact canonical configuration returned by the text endpoint. Returns `image/png`, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, and an inline `.png` filename with the same short stem as the config download. An oversized configuration returns `INVALID_REQUEST` instead of partial image data.

delete.summary: Delete a plan (refused while assigned to users)

preset.description: Server-owned profile policy. Omit this field when sending explicit obfuscation; preset and obfuscation are mutually exclusive.

endpoint_override.description: Canonical hostname or IP address, optionally with port; URLs, paths, whitespace, and control characters are rejected.

patch.description: Name, port, and pool are immutable here. Obfuscation-mode transitions recreate the link (reconcile).

endpoint_override.description: Canonical hostname or IP address, optionally with port; URLs, paths, whitespace, and control characters are rejected.

delete.summary: Delete a profile (refused while devices exist)

post.description: An empty `secret` generates one and returns it exactly once. Signing: `X-WG-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256(secret, "<ts>.<body>")>` with a ~5-minute replay window.

include_reseller_events.description: Owner-only opt-in for a node-wide endpoint to receive reseller customer events. Ordinary operator tokens cannot see or change opted-in endpoints.

patch.summary: Update url/events/enabled or rotate the secret

secret.description: Empty string generates a new secret (returned once)

include_reseller_events.description: Owner-only change to node-wide reseller event fanout.

get.summary: List non-secret delivery receipts for one owned endpoint
get.description: Newest first, retained for seven days. Reseller tokens see only their own endpoint and its tenant-matched events. The response never includes signed payloads, endpoint secrets or URLs. `next_before` is the last delivery ID of this page; pass it as `before` to continue. `event_id` filters exact event identity.

BearerAuth.description: API token: `Authorization: Bearer wg_…` with scopes; separate from admin sessions.

IntegrationKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IntegrationKey.description: 1–128 printable ASCII characters, without spaces. Do not put a secret here. Stable across token rotation within the same owner or reseller namespace.

Conflict.description: Conflict (exists, limit reached, pool exhausted, in use)

username.description: Optional global username; omitted uses a stable generated identifier.

path.description: Secret relative subscription path /sub/{token}; do not log or expose publicly.

code.description: Stable machine code: USER_NOT_FOUND, USERNAME_EXISTS, DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED, TRAFFIC_EXCEEDED, INVALID_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED, NODE_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR, …

Obfuscation.description: Complete supported AmneziaWG profile at the pinned revisions. Scalar-or-range values are inclusive: a scalar is a JSON integer and a true range is canonical string N-M. Enabled H1-H4 intervals must be non-zero and pairwise non-overlapping. AdvancedSecurity is intentionally unsupported.

jc.description: Junk packet count; enabled profiles require 1-128.

jmin.description: Minimum junk size; must be less than jmax.

jmax.description: Maximum junk size; must exceed jmin.

s2.description: Handshake-response padding size; s1 + 56 must not equal s2.

s3.description: Cookie-message padding size; explicit advanced option.

s4.description: Transport-message padding size; explicit advanced option.

h1.description: Inclusive u32 magic-header scalar or range.

h2.description: Inclusive u32 magic-header scalar or range.

h3.description: Inclusive u32 magic-header scalar or range.

h4.description: Inclusive u32 magic-header scalar or range.

i1.description: Canonical single-line UTF-8 signature value; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

i2.description: Canonical single-line UTF-8 signature value; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

i3.description: Canonical single-line UTF-8 signature value; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

i4.description: Canonical single-line UTF-8 signature value; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

i5.description: Canonical single-line UTF-8 signature value; leading/trailing whitespace and control characters are rejected.

header_protection_key.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte HPK. Omit on PATCH to preserve; send an empty string to clear (link recreation required). All S1-S4 values must then be at least 12.

header_protection_key_set.description: Whether an HPK is configured; the key itself is never returned.

content_padding_addition.description: Inclusive u16 content-padding scalar or range; zero uses the backend default.

rekey_after_time.description: Inclusive u16 rekey interval scalar or range in seconds; zero uses the backend default.

rekey_timeout.description: Inclusive u16 rekey timeout scalar or range in seconds; zero uses the backend default.

reject_after_time.description: Inclusive u16 reject-after interval scalar or range in seconds; zero uses the backend default.

keepalive_timeout.description: Inclusive u16 transport keepalive-timeout scalar or range in seconds; distinct from peer PersistentKeepalive.

max_handshake_attempts.description: Inclusive u16 maximum-handshake-attempt scalar or range; zero uses the backend default.

random_trailers.description: Unsafe/client-specific opt-in; generated profiles leave this false.

disable_cookies.description: Unsafe opt-in that weakens DoS protection; generated profiles leave this false.

preset.description: Persisted profile classification; custom is inferred when explicit parameters are supplied.

endpoint_override.description: Canonical hostname or IP address, optionally with port.

next_attempt_at.description: Next scheduled retry while pending; null once delivered or dead.

id.description: Stable event ID; deduplicate redeliveries and crash retries by this value.

reseller_id.description: Present for a reseller-owned endpoint; absent for a node-wide endpoint.

include_reseller_events.description: Owner-approved subscription to reseller customer events for this node-wide endpoint. Always false for a reseller endpoint.

post.description: The configured endpoint receives an at-least-once POST. Return any 2xx to acknowledge; other statuses and transport failures are retried. Deduplicate by body `id`. Delivery may reorder, including across endpoints. A reseller receiver receives only events belonging to its reseller; node.started is node-wide only. A node-wide receiver gets reseller events only after an explicit owner opt-in; existing receivers migrate with that option off.

parameters.name: X-WG-Delivery
parameters.description: Stable delivery ID for this endpoint and event.

parameters.name: X-WG-Signature
parameters.description: t=<unix_seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, '<t>.<raw body>')>. Reject timestamps outside a five-minute replay window.

x-webhooks.description: Events and one pending delivery per subscribed enabled receiver commit with the mutation. Scheduler polls every 5 s, takes up to 64 due deliveries per pass, with up to four concurrent 10 s HTTP requests. Non-2xx and network failures retry after 30 s doubling to a 6 h cap; after webhooks.max_attempts (default 12) the delivery is dead until manually redeliverable. Retention is seven days. Crash after HTTP success but before the SQLite receipt update can duplicate a POST; receivers deduplicate by event id. There is no total, per-user, or cross-endpoint delivery ordering guarantee. Use resource GET and the scoped receipt API to reconcile state. Node-wide endpoints receive reseller events only with explicit owner opt-in.
